about: GET /v1/setup once the account has its Coach: Coach's id and name, and its tools as KIFF has them. Written by tafs cloud's tests (runtime/test/contract.ts); write it again with UPDATE_CONTRACTS=1, never by hand.

lines: See your tafs, their versions and their runs
Read one of a taf's runs
Check what's wrong with a taf
Give a taf a task or a message
Pause or resume a taf's schedule
Draft a door from another application
Set where a taf's results go
Draft a change to a taf
Say what a taf will likely use
Keep what tafs know about your business
Try a version of a taf, sending nothing
Install a version of a taf
See the app on your device while it drives
Tap, type and scroll in the app on your device while it drives

coach_tools_step.title: Give Coach its tools
coach_tools_step.intro: Coach needs these to look after your tafs.
coach_tools_step.row: Coach's tools are waiting for you · Give them

groups.name: Watch your tafs
groups.line: See your tafs and their runs, and find what went wrong.

tools.name: See your tafs
tools.does: Read each taf, its versions and its open runs. Up to 500 a day, counted with “Read a run”.

tools.name: Read a run
tools.does: See what one run did and what it's waiting on. Up to 500 a day, counted with “See your tafs”.
tools.why: A run can hold what your apps answered.

tools.name: Check a taf
tools.does: Find what failed in a taf's latest runs, and the next step. It calls no app. Up to 200 a day.

groups.name: Run them for you
groups.line: Give a taf a task, stop a run, pause a schedule.

tools.name: Give a taf a task
tools.does: Hand a taf a task or a message. The taf works under its own Card. Up to 50 a day; after that, each one waits for you.
tools.why: It starts work in your name.

tools.name: Stop a run
tools.does: Stop a taf's run. Anything in it waiting for you is withdrawn. Up to 50 a day.
tools.why: It ends work you might want finished.

tools.name: Pause a schedule
tools.does: Pause or resume a taf's schedule. Up to 50 a day.
tools.why: A paused taf does nothing until it's resumed.

groups.name: Build new versions
groups.line: Draft and try a taf's next version. Installing it, and changing where results go, always wait for you.

tools.name: Draft a change
tools.does: Write a taf's next version: what starts it, its steps, where results go. Nothing runs from a draft. Up to 20 a day.
tools.why: A draft is what you'd install.

tools.name: Estimate a taf's credits
tools.does: Say what a taf will likely use in a month, from records, before you approve it. It calls no app. Up to 200 a day.
tools.why: It reads your tafs' runs and your plan.

tools.name: Read a public page
tools.does: Read one public web page, such as an app's documentation or its published API description, to connect it the right way. Only public pages, with nothing signed in. Up to 50 a day.
tools.why: It reads only what anyone can open on the web.

tools.name: Label tafs
tools.does: Put labels on your tafs, such as Money or Customers, so you can filter the list. A label is only a name: it changes nothing a taf may do. Up to 100 a day.
tools.why: It changes only how your list is filtered.

tools.name: Gather tafs into a mission
tools.does: Gather tafs that work toward one goal into a mission, such as running the money side. Each taf keeps its own job, apps and Card. Each one waits for your approval.
tools.why: It changes nothing a taf may do.

tools.name: Change a mission's tafs
tools.does: Add a taf to a mission or take one out, or end a mission. Each taf keeps its own job, apps and Card. Up to 50 a day.
tools.why: It changes nothing a taf may do.

tools.name: Keep your business description
tools.does: Keep a short description of your business that you confirmed: what you sell, to whom, your tone and your contact rules. Each one waits for your approval.
tools.why: It's words only, and you see it in Account.

tools.name: Try a version
tools.does: Run a version as a trial that sends nothing to your apps. Up to 20 a day; after that, each one waits for you.
tools.why: A trial reads your apps as the taf would.

tools.name: Install a version
tools.does: Put a version live. Each one waits for your approval.
tools.why: It changes what a taf does.

tools.name: Choose where results go
tools.does: Set where a taf's results go. Each one waits for your approval.
tools.why: Results can leave tafs, by email or into an app.

tools.name: Draft a door for an application
tools.does: Write a door through which your company's own software hands a taf work. Nothing is made from a draft: you approve the door yourself. Up to 20 a day.
tools.why: A draft is what you'd approve.

groups.name: Help while you drive
groups.line: Only while you turn on a drive: see and use tafs on your device. It can never approve anything.

tools.name: See tafs while it drives
tools.does: While you've turned on a drive, see tafs on your device, its own screens only. Up to 2,000 a day.
tools.why: It sees what's on your screen.

tools.name: Use tafs while it drives
tools.does: While a drive is on, tap, type and scroll in tafs on your phone, with a caption for each step. It can't approve anything: only you approve, on your phone. Up to 1,000 a day.
tools.why: It acts in the app as you.
